scope: frozen ten DEV cases only; no labels used

d4_execution_scope.context_bundles: read-only reuse of all 50 MEM-1D1 bundles; no copy, reconstruction, or reorder
d4_execution_scope.question_ids_source: exact MEM-1D1 frozen ten-question selection and MEM-1D3 question-date table

basis: date-complete using the official LongMemEval question_date
minimal extension of the original Health-Copilot v1 answering policy
not category-aware and not tuned to observed DEV failures
source-aligned with the official benchmark Current Date field

future_binding.identity: SHA256 of the exact final_reader_contract.json bytes, verified against final_reader_contract.json.sha256
future_binding.mismatch_behavior: fail closed before cache lookup or reader call

official_source_alignment.evidence_role: source-alignment only; Health-Copilot retains its own shared context-controlled answer head and does not claim exact official prompt reproduction
official_source_alignment.non_cot_prompt_shape: History Chats: {history}; Current Date: {question_date}; Question: {question}; Answer:

prompt_preflight.fullcontext_gate: server prompt token usage must equal tokenizer preflight; prompt_tokens + 256 <= 131072; truncated=false
prompt_preflight.tokenizer: same running frozen llama.cpp /tokenize endpoint, add_special=false

question_date_policy.format: preserve source string byte-for-byte after JSON decoding; do not parse, infer, normalize, or replace with runtime date
question_date_policy.source: exact official LongMemEval-S record question_date copied from the hash-verified MEM-1D3 date table

reader_contract.research_positioning: controlled re-evaluation of public memory architectures under a unified fully-local model stack

template.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON with ensure_ascii=false, sorted keys, compact separators; messages are system then user with the literal template placeholders
template.system_message: Answer questions using only the supplied conversation memory context. Answer concisely but completely, using exact wording when possible. If the requested information is not present, answer None. Do not guess or add unsupported facts.
template.v1_equivalence_rule: Removing the exact Current Date line from the v3 user template yields the v1 user template; the system message is unchanged.

writer_runtime_identity.answer_calls: exactly one per frozen question ID
